description: Elections Commission - A. H. M. Fowzie has been elected as a member of the Ninth Parliament for the Electoral District No. 01 Colombo to fill the Vacancy resignation of M. M. Rahuman
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to a resignation and the declaration of a new Member of Parliament for an electoral district. It involves electoral processes, including the notification of a vacancy, the procedure for filling it under constitutional provisions, and the official declaration of election results. This content falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters, candidate declarations, and parliamentary membership changes resulting from electoral processes.
